title: Extract Neighbor Sets
description: Retrieve the complete set of neighbors for both nodes from the graph. Ensure sets are in a format that supports efficient set operations.

title: Compute Intersection
description: Calculate the intersection of the two neighbor sets: |Γ(u) ∩ Γ(v)|. This represents the shared connections between the nodes.

title: Compute Union
description: Calculate the union of the two neighbor sets: |Γ(u) ∪ Γ(v)|. This represents all distinct connections of both nodes combined.

title: Calculate Jaccard Ratio
description: Divide the size of the intersection by the size of the union. The result is a normalized similarity score between 0 (no common neighbors) and 1 (identical neighbor sets).
